## Benchmark v the seven full portfolios we have seen (15 lineups each; D10 x2, D11 x2, D27, D28 x2)
| Structure per 15 | Theirs: median | Theirs: range | D28 shadow (old rule) | **D29 build** | Read |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Distinct players | 23 | 14-27 | 34 | **20** | In range, a little tight |
| Players in 1 lineup | 5 | 1-7 | 14 | **5** | Match |
| At 80%+ | 1 | 0-4 | 1 | **2** | In range |
| At 50-79% | 5 | 2-7 | 2 | **4** | In range |
| At 25-49% | 5 | 3-7 | 6 | **4** | In range |
| Under 25% | 11 | 4-18 | 25 | **10** | In range |
| Roster spots from 50%+ players | 57% | 43-80% | 30% | **64%** | In range, upper half |
| Shared players per pair | 3.4 | 2.9-5.0 | 2.5 | **3.8** (max 6) | In range |
| Players 40%+ owned per lineup | 1.6 | 1.1-3.0 | 1.7 | **0.9** | **Below range** |
| Players 20-40% owned | 2.2 | 1.4-4.2 | 1.1 | **3.2** | In range |
| Players under 10% owned | 0.7 | 0.2-2.2 | 2.7 | **0.7** | Match (we were 4x too high) |
| Our value rank 1-5 | 2.0 | 1.5-3.0 | 2.5 | **2.7** | In range, upper |
| Value rank 6-15 | 2.0 | 1.0-3.3 | 1.5 | **2.1** | Match |
| Value rank 16-30 | 0.5 | 0.1-1.9 | 1.6 | **0.8** | In range |
| Value rank 31+ | 1.9 | 0.1-4.4 | 1.5 | **1.3** | In range |

**Honest read**
- The exposure rows (players used, one-offs, 80%+, 50-79%, shared) match **by construction**: I set those limits in `calls.json`. They prove the build follows the rules, not that the rules are right.
- The rows I did NOT set are the real test: low-owned players per lineup (0.7), value-rank bands and 20-40% owned all land inside their range. That is a good sign.
- **One gap: chalk.** 0.9 players per lineup at 40%+ owned v their 1.6. Cause: I capped the NYK stars (blowout rule) and Giannis shows 37% in our field model. Our model under-owns chalk by ~6 pts, so the true figure is probably 1.2-1.5. Still the lowest in the table. If you want it closer: let Towns go to 6, or add Wagner-style chalk as a second anchor.
- Their stars run cheaper: 0.4 players at 17M+ per lineup (D27) v our Giannis in 14 of 15. Our build is star-heavy at the top compared with the cheap-core users.
- Benchmark is shape only. Their results (30%+ cash) come from who they picked, not just the shape. We will only know from real results.
